relationships.subject: anti-VEGF intravitreal injection
relationships.evidence_quote: Non-infectious intraocular inflammation appears to be a real complication of anti-VEGF intravitreal injections with outcomes apparently favorable compared to infectious endophthalmitis [28].

key_findings: Of 83,145 IVI, incidence was 0.031% for infectious endophthalmitis and 0.028% for non-infectious IOI
VA improved significantly after NI-IOI but not after infectious endophthalmitis
